items.curatedReasonEn: This monthly news roundup offers a quick pulse check on how the physical therapy profession is being portrayed in public media in the U.S. While specific content isn't yet available, you can use this to gauge PR trends and public perception of PT.

items.title: Benefits and limitations of robotic gait exoskeletons in functional rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy: an umbrella review.
items.summary: An umbrella review found Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) improves overall motor function, specifically GMFM-88 dimensions D and E, in children with cerebral palsy. However, improvements in spatiotemporal gait parameters were inconsistent, and RAGT did not consistently outperform treadmill training or conventional physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 针对脑瘫儿童，机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）在整体运动功能上优于传统康复或跑步机训练，特别是在粗大运动功能量表GMFM-88的D和E维度。但在步态时空参数的改善上效果不一致，提示它作为辅助手段更有价值。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫儿童功能康复中机器人步态外骨骼的益处与局限性：一项伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述显示，机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能改善脑瘫儿童的整体运动功能，尤其在GMFM-88的D和E维度上。然而，其对步态时空参数的改善效果不一致，且未显示出相比跑步机训练或传统物理治疗的持续优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with cerebral palsy, Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) shows superiority in overall motor function over conventional or treadmill training, particularly in GMFM-88 dimensions D and E. However, its effects on spatiotemporal gait parameters are inconsistent, suggesting its value as a complementary intervention.
items.limitation: 该综述未报告除GMFM-88外的其他临床、运动学、动力学或肌电图测量，可能限制了对RAGT全面效果的评估。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report clinical, kinematic, kinetic, or EMG measures other than GMFM-88, which may limit the comprehensive evaluation of RAGT's effects.

items.title: Interval Between Injury and Surgery Influences Knee Biomechanics During Walking in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstructed Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 studies found that delayed ACL reconstruction (≥12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits in walking biomechanics, while early surgery (<6 months) correlates with fewer long-term sagittal-plane deficits but may have temporary frontal-plane asymmetries.
items.curatedReason: 很明确，ACL 重建最好别拖。如果患者术前等待时间超过 12 个月，你就要做好长期矢状面步态缺陷的康复准备。反之，若能在 6 个月内手术，长期矢状面缺陷会少很多，但要留意术后可能出现的暂时性冠状面不对称。
items.titleZh: 损伤与手术间隔时间影响前交叉韧带重建患者行走时的膝关节生物力学：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对16项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，延迟前交叉韧带重建（≥12个月）与行走生物力学中的矢状面缺陷持续存在相关，而早期手术（<6个月）则与较少的长期矢状面缺陷相关，但可能存在暂时的额状面不对称。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't delay ACL reconstruction. If your patient waits ≥12 months pre-surgery, prepare for persistent sagittal plane gait deficits in their long-term rehab. Conversely, early surgery (<6 months) significantly reduces long-term sagittal plane deficits, though you might see temporary frontal plane asymmetries post-op.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的异质性较高，尤其在膝关节屈曲力矩（I² = 76%）和长期膝关节屈曲力矩（I² = 88%）的分析中，可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity, particularly in analyses of peak knee flexion moment (I² = 76%) and long-term peak knee flexion moment (I² = 88%), which may affect result stability.

items.title: Inertial measurement unit-based gait analysis for objective assessment of vestibular rehabilitation.
items.summary: IMU-based gait analysis, even with a single pelvis sensor, captured significant improvements in walking speed, Gait Profile Score, and cadence in 30 acute vestibular syndrome patients after 6 weeks of vestibular rehabilitation, maintained at 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使使用单个惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器也能捕捉到急性前庭综合征患者步态的改善，这为在临床实践中更广泛地采用可穿戴设备进行客观评估提供了可行性证据。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性测量单元的步态分析对前庭康复进行客观评估
items.summaryZh: 即使只使用单个骨盆传感器，基于惯性测量单元的步态分析也能捕捉到30名急性前庭综合征患者在6周前庭康复后步行速度、步态剖面评分和步频的显著改善，并在12周随访中保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that even a single inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor can capture gait improvements in patients with acute vestibular syndrome, providing feasibility evidence for wider adoption of wearable devices for objective assessment in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小（30名AVS患者），且对照组只进行了一次评估，可能无法完全反映对照组的变异性。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small (30 AVS patients), and the control group was assessed only once, which may not fully reflect control group variability.

items.title: Physiotherapy and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation for Mental Health: A Two-Decade Bibliometric Analysis of Global Trends, Thematic Evolution, and the Socioeconomic Vulnerability Gap (2006-2025).
items.summary: A bibliometric analysis of 5223 publications (2006-2025) on physical rehabilitation and mental health found a 22.6-fold increase in annual publications, with 75.9% originating from high-income countries and socioeconomic vulnerability identified as an under-researched thematic cluster.
items.curatedReason: 这份文献计量分析显示，物理康复与心理健康交叉领域的研究显著增长，但高收入国家贡献了绝大部分。这提醒你，在低资源环境下，针对社会经济脆弱人群的成本效益和实施科学研究是未来的重要方向。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗和运动康复对心理健康的影响：一项关于全球趋势、主题演变和社会经济脆弱性差距（2006-2025）的二十年文献计量分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对2006-2025年间物理康复与心理健康领域5223篇出版物的文献计量分析发现，年发文量增长了22.6倍，其中75.9%来自高收入国家，社会经济脆弱性被识别为一个研究不足的主题群。
items.curatedReasonEn: This bibliometric analysis reveals substantial growth in research at the intersection of physical rehabilitation and mental health, with high-income countries contributing the majority. This indicates that in low-resource settings, cost-effectiveness and implementation science research for socioeconomically vulnerable populations are critical future directions.
items.limitation: 社会经济脆弱性关键词的识别存在较高的假阳性率（62.5%），可能导致对该主题覆盖范围的误判。
items.limitationEn: The keyword identification for socioeconomic vulnerability had a high false-positive rate (62.5%), potentially leading to misestimation of topic coverage.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Early Prediction of Discharge Outcomes in Geriatric Rehabilitation: Development and Temporal Validation of a Multiclass Model
items.summary: A multiclass prediction model developed using multinomial regression and XGBoost accurately predicted discharge outcomes (minimal dependency, nursing-care dependency, or medical deterioration) in 10,920 geriatric rehabilitation patients by day 7, achieving an AUC of 0.81.
items.curatedReason: 这个多分类模型能在亚急性康复第7天有效预测老年患者的三个出院结局，其 AUC 达到 0.81。这提示你可以在早期利用这类工具识别高危患者，更早启动社工介入或加强对恶化风险的监测。
items.titleZh: 老年康复出院结局的早期预测：多分类模型的开发与时间验证
items.summaryZh: 一项使用多项式回归和 XGBoost 开发的多分类预测模型，在10920名老年康复患者中，能在第7天准确预测出院结局（最低依赖、护理依赖或医疗恶化），AUC 达到0.81。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multiclass model effectively predicts three discharge outcomes for geriatric patients on day 7 of subacute rehabilitation, with an AUC of 0.81. This suggests you can use such tools early to identify high-risk patients, initiating social work involvement sooner or increasing monitoring for deterioration risk.
items.limitation: 模型是在一家公立老年康复医院的单一健康维护组织成员数据上开发的，结果在不同机构或人群中的通用性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed using data from members of a single HMO at a public geriatric rehabilitation hospital; its generalizability to other institutions or populations requires further validation.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 12 physiotherapists in South Africa identified limited undergraduate training, inadequate resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways as barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders in public hospitals.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示南非公立医院物理治疗师在盆底功能障碍管理上面临的挑战，包括培训不足、资源匮乏和转诊系统不完善，这在一定程度上反映了全球基层医疗的共性问题。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 地区公立医院物理治疗师在盆底功能障碍管理中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非12名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员配备不足以及转诊路径不畅是公立医院盆底功能障碍管理的主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights challenges faced by physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders in South African public hospitals, including inadequate training, resource scarcity, and poor referral systems, reflecting common issues in global primary healthcare.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Health-seeking behaviours of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of five studies found that health-seeking behaviors for osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa are often delayed or fragmented, influenced by beliefs, poor knowledge, limited person-centered care, and access barriers.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出了撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者就医行为的延迟和碎片化。这提示你，在资源受限地区，加强患者教育、推广自我管理和拓展社区康复服务尤为重要。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项研究的范围综述发现，撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为常延迟或碎片化，受信念、知识不足、以患者为中心的护理有限以及服务障碍等因素影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights delayed and fragmented health-seeking behaviors among osteoarthritis patients in sub-Saharan Africa. This suggests that in resource-limited settings, strengthening patient education, promoting self-management, and expanding community-based rehabilitation are particularly crucial.
items.limitation: 纳入的文献数量非常有限，且主要集中在尼日利亚和南非的农村地区，限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The review included a very limited number of studies, primarily from rural Nigeria and South Africa, which restricts the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: A COSMIN systematic review of performance-based assessment tools for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease: a linking study based on the ICF framework.
items.summary: A COSMIN systematic review identified only two performance-based outcome measurement instruments (PerFOMs) for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease, the Mealtime Assessment Scale and a modified OARS scale, neither of which has been fully validated for content.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒你，帕金森病患者的进餐困难不只局限于吞咽，还涉及姿势、餐具使用和认知注意力。仅有的两种基于表现的评估工具均未完全验证，你需要更全面地评估患者的进餐能力，而不仅仅是吞咽功能。
items.titleZh: COSMIN 系统综述评估帕金森病患者进餐表现的基于表现的评估工具：一项基于 ICF 框架的关联研究
items.summaryZh: 一项 COSMIN 系统综述确定了帕金森病患者进餐表现的两种基于表现的评估工具：进餐评估量表和改良版老年美国人资源和服务量表，但两者均未进行全面的内容验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review reminds you that mealtime difficulties in Parkinson's disease extend beyond swallowing, involving posture, utensil handling, and cognitive-attentional demands. The only two performance-based assessment tools identified are not fully validated, so you need to assess patients' overall mealtime abilities more comprehensively, not just swallowing function.
items.limitation: 仅有两项研究被纳入，且评估工具的验证证据有限，限制了对现有工具的可靠性判断。
items.limitationEn: Only two studies were included, and evidence for the validation of assessment tools is limited, restricting reliable judgment of existing instruments.

items.title: Five Days of Acute Intermittent Hypoxia Is Safe and Improves Somatic Motor Function in Persons with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled crossover trial in ambulatory MS patients found daily acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) was safe and significantly improved ankle plantarflexion torque (17.5% post-intervention, 29.2% at follow-up) and 6-Minute Walk Test distance (β=10.14 m, p=0.039) compared to sham.
items.curatedReason: 这项双盲交叉 RCT 首次验证了间歇性低氧（AIH）对多发性硬化症（MS）患者的安全性和疗效。AIH 显著提高了踝关节跖屈肌力（17.5% 即时改善，29.2% 随访改善）和 6 分钟步行距离，为你在 MS 康复中探索神经可塑性增强干预提供了高潜力新路径。
items.titleZh: 五天急性间歇性低氧在多发性硬化症患者中安全且可改善躯体运动功能
items.summaryZh: 一项针对可步行 MS 患者的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验发现，每日急性间歇性低氧（AIH）安全且显著改善了踝关节跖屈肌力（干预后 17.5%，随访时 29.2%）和 6 分钟步行距离（β=10.14 m, p=0.039），相比假干预效果更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This double-masked crossover RCT is the first to validate the safety and efficacy of acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS). AIH significantly improved ankle plantarflexion torque (17.5% immediate, 29.2% at follow-up) and 6-Minute Walk Test distance, offering a high-potential new avenue for you to explore neuroplasticity-enhancing interventions in MS rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该试验没有将 AIH 与特定的任务导向步态训练相结合，因此其协同效应尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The trial did not combine AIH with task-specific gait training, so its synergistic effects are unknown.

items.title: Final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Has Mixed Payment Impact for Physical Therapy
items.summary: The 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule includes changes to practice expense calculations expected to improve physical therapist service values over time, but also features conversion factor reductions and mixed results for remote therapeutic monitoring provisions.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）公布的 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则，对物理治疗报销具有复杂影响。你需要仔细审查这些变化，因为它们将直接影响你的报销费率和远程治疗服务的实践。
items.titleZh: 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则对物理治疗的支付影响复杂
items.summaryZh: 2027 年医疗保险医师收费标准最终规则包括对实践支出计算的修改，预计将随着时间推移改善物理治疗服务的价值，但也包含了转换因子削减和远程治疗监测条款的复杂结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has released its final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule rule, which has complex implications for physical therapy reimbursement. You need to carefully review these changes, as they will directly impact your reimbursement rates and the practice of remote therapeutic monitoring services.

items.title: Ultrasound-guided versus landmark-guided injections in musculoskeletal practice: a scoping review of clinical efficacy, educational needs, and economic considerations
items.summary: A scoping review of 29 studies found ultrasound-guided (US) injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may provide short-term symptomatic benefit at selected sites (shoulder, knee, elbow). However, comparative clinical superiority at longer follow-up and cost-effectiveness remain undetermined.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述表明，超声引导注射可可靠提高注射准确性，并在特定部位提供短期症状缓解，但长期临床优越性和成本效益尚无定论。它提醒你，在将超声引导注射常规化之前，仍需权衡患者解剖特点、临床需求和经济因素。
items.titleZh: 超声引导与体表标志引导注射在肌肉骨骼实践中的对比：临床疗效、教育需求和经济考量范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 29 项研究的范围综述发现，超声引导（US）注射可可靠地提高置入准确性，并在选定部位（肩、膝、肘）提供短期症状改善。然而，在较长随访期内的比较临床优越性和成本效益仍未确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that ultrasound-guided injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may offer short-term symptomatic relief at selected sites, but long-term clinical superiority and cost-effectiveness are not established. It reminds you to weigh patient anatomy, clinical requirements, and economic considerations before routinely adopting ultrasound-guided injections.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性高，且缺乏统一的经济学分析模型，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: High methodological heterogeneity among included studies and a lack of uniform economic analysis models limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - CEO update to the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum
items.summary: Ahpra's CEO updated the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum on changes in healthcare regulation, emphasizing the upcoming milestone of regulating nearly one million health practitioners in Australia and New Zealand, and addressing conflicts of interest and clinical governance amid evolving business models and technology.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）CEO 的这份更新强调了医疗监管环境的变化，特别是对利益冲突和临床治理的关注。这提醒你必须重新审视你的执业行为和商业模式，确保符合最新的职业行为准则，以避免潜在的患者安全问题。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——CEO 对 RACS 外科领导论坛的更新
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）首席执行官向皇家澳大拉西亚外科医生学院外科领导论坛通报了医疗监管的变化，强调了澳大利亚和新西兰近百万健康从业者监管的重要里程碑，并讨论了在不断变化的商业模式和技术背景下的利益冲突和临床治理问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This update from the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) CEO highlights changes in the healthcare regulatory environment, particularly regarding conflicts of interest and clinical governance. This reminds you to re-evaluate your practice and business models to ensure compliance with the latest professional conduct guidelines, to avoid potential patient safety issues.

items.title: Integrated Decision-Making Under Uncertainty in High-Performance Sport Support Systems
items.summary: A narrative review proposes a framework for integrated decision-making in high-performance sport support systems, combining established decision principles with qualitative triage. It outlines five interdependent functions for integrated work and emphasizes athlete values, decision rights, and coaches' roles.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为高水平运动支持系统中的决策制定提供了一个框架，强调了在不确定性下整合证据和专业判断的重要性。它能帮助你优化你的跨学科协作方式，更好地将科学推理应用于运动员的康复与表现管理。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动支持系统中不确定性下的整合决策 | 运动医学 - 开放
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述提出了一种高水平运动支持系统中整合决策的框架，结合了既定的决策原则和定性分类。它概述了整合工作的五个相互依赖的功能，并强调了运动员价值观、决策权和教练角色的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In high-performance sport support systems, you need to integrate established decision principles with qualitative triage, rather than relying on a single model. The framework provided by this review can help you optimize interdisciplinary collaboration and better integrate evidence with professional judgment under uncertainty.
items.limitation: 该框架仍是概念性的，其内容效度、可用性、分类一致性、实施负担和决策过程仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The framework remains conceptual, and its content validity, usability, triage consistency, implementation burden, and decision processes require further evaluation.

items.title: Routine physical function assessment may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis
items.summary: A commentary on a nested case-control study (Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062) suggests that routine assessment of gait speed, grip strength, and frailty may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis, advocating for their inclusion in longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 日常体能评估（如步速、握力和衰弱程度）不仅关乎身体健康，也可能预示认知功能。这项述评提示你，将这些评估纳入对老年人的常规监测，有望在痴呆诊断前数年识别高风险个体，为早期干预或延缓认知衰退争取时间。
items.titleZh: 常规身体功能评估或可在痴呆诊断前数年识别患病风险增加的老年人
items.summaryZh: 一项对巢式病例对照研究（Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062）的述评指出，常规评估步速、握力和衰弱程度可能在痴呆诊断前数年识别出患病风险增加的老年人，并倡导将其纳入长期监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Routine physical function assessments (e.g., gait speed, grip strength, and frailty) are not only about physical health but may also predict cognitive function. This commentary suggests incorporating these assessments into routine monitoring of older adults, potentially identifying high-risk individuals years before a dementia diagnosis, allowing time for early intervention or delaying cognitive decline.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于对现有证据的解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary rather than an original research study, so its conclusions are based on an interpretation of existing evidence.

items.title:
Stakeholder priorities for rehabilitation to support functioning at home and work among people on sick leave due to low back pain: a group concept mapping study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A group concept mapping study (n=101) identified six stakeholder-prioritized clusters for low back pain rehabilitation for people on sick leave: self-management, physical training, workplace involvement, interdisciplinary coordination, individual support, and extended assessment. All clusters received high importance ratings.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究清晰地界定了因腰痛病假人群对康复的优先需求，涵盖了自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与等六大集群。它强调了以患者为中心、跨部门协调的康复模式，能够指导你优化对这类患者的综合康复策略，促进他们重返家庭和工作。
items.titleZh: 因腰痛请病假人群的康复利益相关者优先事项，以支持居家和工作功能：一项团体概念图研究
items.summaryZh: 一项团体概念图研究（n=101）确定了因腰痛请病假人群的六个利益相关者优先康复集群：自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与、跨学科协调、个体支持和扩展评估。所有集群均获得高度重要性评价。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study clearly defines the rehabilitation priorities for people on sick leave due to low back pain, covering six clusters including self-management, physical training, and workplace involvement. It emphasizes patient-centered, cross-sectoral coordinated rehabilitation models, which can guide you in optimizing comprehensive rehabilitation strategies for these patients, promoting their return to home and work.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且参与者仅来自丹麦，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, and participants were only from Denmark, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The MSK Playbook: Hamstring Strain Injuries - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: A BJSM blog post reviews hamstring strain injuries, their increasing incidence (24% of all professional football injuries) and high recurrence rates (over 30%). It covers injury mechanisms, biomechanics, imaging, and rehab protocols for this common sports injury.
items.curatedReason: 腘绳肌拉伤的发生率已占职业足球所有损伤的 24%，复发率更超 30%，这表明现有康复方案仍有不足。这份博客文章提供了一个全面框架，你可以用它来审视自己的康复协议，尤其是在理解损伤机制和避免再次损伤方面。
items.titleZh: MSK 攻略：腘绳肌拉伤
items.summaryZh: 一篇 BJSM 博客文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤，指出其发病率不断上升（占职业橄榄球所有损伤的 24%），复发率高（超过 30%）。文章涵盖了这种常见运动损伤的损伤机制、生物力学、影像学和康复方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hamstring strain injuries account for 24% of all professional football injuries, with recurrence rates exceeding 30%, indicating deficiencies in current rehabilitation protocols. This blog post offers a comprehensive framework you can use to scrutinize your own rehab protocols, especially regarding injury mechanisms and preventing re-injury.

items.title: Efficacy of Manual Physiotherapy Techniques for Improving Cervical Range of Motion in Infants With Congenital Muscular Torticollis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of five RCTs (n=143 infants) found manual physiotherapy techniques significantly improved cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis (Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001), indicating a large overall effect with low heterogeneity.
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈部活动度方面，短期效果显著且证据坚实。在临床实践中，你应该将其作为这类婴儿早期干预的一线选择。
items.titleZh: 手法物理治疗技术改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度的疗效：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项 RCT（143 名婴儿）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手法物理治疗技术能显著改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿的颈椎活动度（Cohen's d = 0.90，95% CI：0.54 至 1.27，p < 0.001），显示出较大的总体效应且异质性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual therapy demonstrably improves cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis in the short term, with strong evidence from this review. You should confidently position it as a first-line intervention for these infants in early clinical practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量较少（5 项 RCTs），且干预方案存在异质性，目前尚缺乏长期随访数据支持。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis included a small number of studies (5 RCTs), showed variability in intervention protocols, and lacked long-term follow-up data.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Independent Walking 8 Weeks After Rehabilitation in Patients With Stroke: A Retrospective Study.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of 169 stroke patients found machine learning models, especially neural networks, provided good discrimination (AUCs 0.839-0.884) for predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-rehabilitation, with BBS and SEP severity being leading predictors.
items.curatedReason: 预测卒中后 8 周独立行走能力对康复计划至关重要。该研究提示机器学习模型结合临床和躯体感觉指标，预测准确性优于传统方法，有助于早期分层和干预。
items.titleZh: 机器学习预测卒中患者康复后 8 周的独立行走能力：一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 169 名卒中患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，机器学习模型，特别是神经网络，在预测康复后 8 周独立行走方面表现出良好的区分能力（AUC 0.839-0.884），其中 BBS 和 SEP 严重程度是主要预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: Predicting independent walking ability 8 weeks post-stroke is crucial for rehabilitation planning. This study suggests that machine learning models, integrating clinical and somatosensory measures, offer superior predictive accuracy compared to conventional methods, aiding early stratification and intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，且缺乏外部验证，结果尚不能直接应用于临床。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective cohort study lacking external validation, so the findings cannot be directly applied clinically yet.

items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society expert consensus statement, developed via a modified Delphi process with 17 clinicians, achieved over 80% agreement on 54 statements concerning athletic hamstring injury management, emphasizing standardized classification, individualized criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive loading, and multi-faceted return-to-sport criteria.
items.curatedReason: 这份由17位专家达成80%以上共识的声明，为腘绳肌损伤管理提供了明确的指导方针。这意味着你应当推行标准化的分类、个性化且基于标准的康复方案，并采用多维度评估来决定运动员何时重返赛场。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS学会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 一份由17位临床专家通过改良德尔菲法制定的ICCUS学会共识声明，在运动性腘绳肌损伤管理的54项声明上达成80%以上共识，强调了标准化分类、个体化基于标准的康复、渐进式负荷以及多方面重返运动标准的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus, agreed upon by 17 experts with over 80% concordance, offers clear guidelines for hamstring injury management. You should adopt standardized classification, implement individualized and criterion-based rehabilitation, and utilize multi-faceted assessments for return-to-sport decisions.
items.limitation: 德尔菲共识依赖于专家意见，而非直接的随机对照试验数据，可能存在专家组自身偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Delphi consensus relies on expert opinions rather than direct randomized controlled trial data, which may introduce bias from the expert panel itself.

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: In a 6-month prospective cohort study of 112 stroke patients, stride time variability (STV) at discharge, with an optimal cutoff of 3.40% (AUC 0.756, sensitivity 88.2%, specificity 53.8%), was identified as the sole independent predictor of post-discharge falls, outperforming conventional measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，卒中患者出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV）是预测其出院后6个月内跌倒风险的独立指标，其3.40%的截断值可辅助早期风险识别。这提示你在临床实践中应常规评估STV，并对高风险患者实施有针对性的跌倒预防干预。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险预测指标：一项6个月随访的队列研究和生存分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对112名卒中患者进行6个月随访的前瞻性队列研究显示，出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV），以3.40%为最佳截断值（AUC 0.756，敏感性88.2%，特异性53.8%），是出院后跌倒的唯一独立预测因子，优于其他常规测量指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study indicates that stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of fall risk within 6 months post-discharge for stroke patients, with a 3.40% cutoff value aiding early risk identification. This suggests you should routinely assess STV in clinical practice and implement targeted fall prevention interventions for high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心样本，可能限制了STV截断值的普适性，需要多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's single-center sample may limit the generalizability of the STV cutoff value, requiring multi-center validation.
